bug_semantics: Authenticated instance-level MCP (global:member) can pass an attacker-chosen node type into @n8n/workflow-sdk schema loading. loadSchema/tryLoadSchemaForNodeType split that type into pkg/nodeName and path.join() those components under the schema nodes/ root, then require() the resulting module with no separator, NUL, or '..' rejection and no realpath containment check. A type such as x.../../../evil therefore resolves outside the schema tree; Node loads and executes the attacker file in the n8n MAIN process (CWE-22 path traversal to RCE). The MCP validate-node tool feeds node.type straight into validateNodeConfig; validateWorkflow does the same from workflow JSON node.type. Vendor GHSA-6h4x-896x-fw5m (published 2026-08-05) and CVE-2026-77068 (VulnCheck, CVE.org published, not withdrawn/rejected) describe this loader. Patched in n8n 2.33.4 and 2.34.1 by rejecting unsafe path components and requiring require.resolve() to land inside the realpath of nodesRoot.
flaw_origin: The unsafe mapping was first written in reconstructable PR #24535 member 6d88b9e1e9f24901985b1fb4e4200f18bd550e1b (2026-01-28), feat(workflow-sdk): integrate Zod schema validation into validate(), which added packages/@n8n/workflow-sdk/src/validation/schema-validator.ts. That commit introduced nodeTypeToPathComponents (split on '.', strip only a leading @n8n/), path.join(schemaBasePath, 'nodes', pkg, nodeName, version+'.schema'), and require(schemaPath) with no traversal guard, then called validateNodeConfig(node.type, ...) from validateWorkflow. Immediate parent d5f2772381a8d91592fd47845fef5422f80cf9d9 lacks the file and the loadSchema/require-from-node-type mechanism. GitHub squash 9729c2a5da7b59fdbf62b95c100e085a2c2daa4d (#24535, n8n@2.9.0) is the first mainline carrier, not the BIC. Later tryLoadSchemaModule refactors preserved the same unsanitized join+require; MCP validate_node_config (#31047) only exposed the existing sink to member-supplied type strings.
evidence: CVE.org CVE-2026-77068 (CNA VulnCheck, updated 2026-08-21, not withdrawn/rejected): n8n @n8n/workflow-sdk node-schema loader used for MCP node-schema loading derives the schema module path from the attacker-supplied node type without validating path-traversal sequences; authenticated global:member can cause MAIN-process code execution. Affected 2.0.0 before 2.33.4 and 2.34.0 before 2.34.1. First-party GHSA-6h4x-896x-fw5m published 2026-08-05 (withdrawn_at null). GHSA-h5rm-9fhh-5phj is the unreviewed GitHub Advisory Database row for the CVE.
